scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — verified omissions from current category

records.name: Reverse Shot
records.effect: Fires four tracking Ki bullets; after missing for about a second, they loop back toward the opponent. Red health increases the volley to eight blasts.

records.name: Revenge Final Flash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 124 - Downfall of the Ultimate Saiyan
records.effect: Fires a chargeable Final Flash-style beam; holding the input consumes additional Ki and extends the beam. Red health further increases its duration and hit count.

records.name: Destructive Ray
records.effect: Fires twin eye beams that stun the opponent for about one second.

records.name: Eye Beam
records.effect: Fires a narrow eye beam at the opponent and briefly stuns on hit.

records.name: Senko Ki Blast
records.effect: Fires a fast Ki blast followed by a bright flash that can obscure the opponent's view.

records.name: Kill Driver
records.effect: Fires a rapid Ki projectile; additional input can continue the sequence with a second shot.

records.name: Sudden Storm
records.effect: Fires a rapid multi-shot Ki barrage that can track the opponent.

records.name: Darkness Twin Star
records.effect: Fires two dark Ki projectiles that can be chained into a follow-up attack.

records.name: Darkness Eye Beam
records.effect: Fires dark eye beams that stun the opponent briefly.

reconciliation_note: Emperor's Blast was already present locally and was intentionally not duplicated. The nine records above were absent from docs/data/skills.json before this batch. Current individual pages establish the listed Ki costs and classifications; PQ Ultimate Finish requirements remain null unless explicitly established.
